hook: Argo floats show ocean productivity falling in the Atlantic and Southern Oceans, rising in the Pacific.
summary: Depth-resolving robotic floats indicate that marine plant production is declining across the Atlantic and Southern Oceans and increasing in the Pacific. The authors fed biogeochemical-Argo data into a carbon-based production algorithm and found trends that mostly match satellite estimates. The record is short, and the abstract does not show these trends are caused by climate change.
title: Basin-scale changes in net primary production from the biogeochemical-Argo array.
